title: Navigent: A Geometry-Grounded Agentic Framework for Vision Language Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2611.34249v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) with general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offers a flexible alternative to task-specific navigation policies, while reliable long-horizon execution remains challenging. Agents must track navigation progress, detect discrepancies between commanded and actual motion, and recognize when movement has passed relevant landmarks or entrances. We present Navigent, an agentic VLN framework built around a frozen MLLM and a Geometry-Grounded Execution Critic (GEC). GEC performs two complementary checks: action-to-motion consistency, which evaluates measured displacement against commanded movement, and motion-to-landmark consistency, which tracks agent-selected visual anchors and entrance candidates in world coordinates. Detected discrepancies interrupt the remaining action sequence and trigger reobservation, local adjustment, or node-based recovery. Historical visual memory supports progress

translated_title: Navigent：一种基于几何依据的视觉语言导航智能体框架
translated_abstract: 基于通用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的视觉语言导航（VLN）为任务特定的导航策略提供了一种灵活的替代方案，但可靠的长时程执行仍然充满挑战。智能体必须跟踪导航进度、检测指令运动与实际运动之间的差异，并识别运动何时已经越过了相关地标或入口。我们提出了 Navigent，一个围绕冻结的 MLLM 和几何依据执行评判器（Geometry-Grounded Execution Critic，GEC）构建的智能体式 VLN 框架。GEC 执行两项互补的检查：动作-运动一致性，评估实际测量的位移是否符合指令运动；以及运动-地标一致性，在世界坐标系中跟踪智能体选择的视觉锚点和候选入口。检测到的差异会中断剩余的动作序列，并触发重新观测、局部调整或基于节点的恢复。历史视觉记忆为进度跟踪提供支持。
tldr: 提出了 Navigent 框架，通过几何依据执行评判器（GEC）检测指令动作、实际位移与地标观测之间的不一致，从而在冻结的多模态大语言模型基础上实现可靠的长时程视觉语言导航。
en_tdlr: Navigent is an agentic VLN framework that couples a frozen MLLM with a Geometry-Grounded Execution Critic, which detects discrepancies between commanded actions, measured motion, and landmark observations to enable reliable long-horizon navigation.
